title: CSS Checkbox Styler
description: Design custom checkboxes — colors, size, check style — with a working live preview and CSS.
howto: Pick the accent color, box size and corner radius.
Choose the check mark style (check or dash).
Copy the code or download the self-contained checkbox.html.

faqs.q: How does the custom checkbox work?
faqs.a: The native input is visually hidden but stays focusable; a styled span draws the box and the check mark appears via the :checked selector.
Yes — it is a real checkbox input with a label, so screen readers and keyboard focus work normally.

faqs.q: Can I use it in forms?
faqs.a: Yes — the input keeps its name/value behavior, so it submits like a normal checkbox.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with cb- to avoid collisions.
